parameters.query:
-- Claim atomically: the INSERT is what makes a row ours, so two overlapping runs
-- can never send the same alert twice. Service-hours guard keeps it from waking
-- anyone at 04:00 for something the kitchen cannot act on anyway.
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT v.* FROM public.v_dlq_alerts_needing_human v
  WHERE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::int BETWEEN 10 AND 23
  ORDER BY v.created_at
  LIMIT 5
),
claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO public.dlq_alert_notifications (dlq_alert_id, channel)
  SELECT c.id, 'whatsapp' FROM candidates c
  ON CONFLICT (dlq_alert_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING dlq_alert_id
)
SELECT c.id,
       CASE c.location_key
         WHEN 'LOC_AALST'   THEN 'Tipzakske'
         WHEN 'LOC_BERLARE' THEN 'Frietbooster'
         WHEN 'LOC_DENDER'  THEN 'Frietchalet'
         ELSE COALESCE(c.location_key,'?') END AS store_key,
       left(
         CASE WHEN c.queue_name = 'ls_receipt_stuck' THEN ''
              ELSE 'Order ' || COALESCE(replace(c.external_ref,'Takeaway - ',''),'?') || ' did NOT reach the POS. ' END
         || CASE
              WHEN c.queue_name = 'q_orders_push_ls'   THEN 'Reason: ' || left(c.message,90)
              WHEN c.queue_name = 'takeaway_accept'    THEN 'Takeaway would not accept it automatically.'
              WHEN c.queue_name = 'takeaway_aged_out'  THEN 'It was on Takeaway but we picked it up too late.'
              WHEN c.queue_name = 'q_orders_push_shipday' THEN 'Delivery dispatch failed: ' || left(c.message,80)
              WHEN c.queue_name = 'ls_receipt_stuck'   THEN left(c.message,200)
              ELSE left(c.message,90) END
         || CASE WHEN c.queue_name = 'ls_receipt_stuck' THEN '' ELSE ' Please check the tablet and handle it manually.' END
       , 300) AS message_text
FROM candidates c
JOIN claimed cl ON cl.dlq_alert_id = c.id;
